novelty_search.nearest_results: The valid will/had depth sweep localizes the subject-onset sufficiency crossing to boundary 9: recovery rises from 0.3798/0.3546 at boundary 8 to 0.6445/0.5052 at boundary 9. A previous cross-task deep-value block-8 factorial was invalid by a narrowly missed float closure and did not test this construction or end-to-end semantic source-state intervention.
novelty_search.new_question: Which exact additive component of block 8 creates the late will/had subject-onset payload: carried entry state, attention update, or MLP update?

population: All 64 sealed A1/A2 will/had rows, split into two fixed 32-row construction batches.

components.block8_entry_z8: The carried block-8 entry term after the learned residual/embedding mixture and before attention.
components.mlp8_update: The complete block-8 MLP output after its native attention-stage input.

factorial.arms: All eight subsets of the three components. At the two exact subject-onset positions, assemble the boundary-9 state from base components except for donor components named by the arm; retain every other base position and the full base suffix.
factorial.closure: The empty arm must reproduce base behavior and the all-components arm must reproduce exact paired donor boundary-9 source-state replacement. Shapley values must sum to the all-minus-empty effect.

opposing_predictions.attention_writer: Block-8 attention has the largest positive Shapley value in both constructions and omitting it causes a material loss from the full source-state effect.
opposing_predictions.mlp_or_carried_writer: The MLP update or carried entry state dominates in either construction, or attention omission is immaterial.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_cube: All hashes and native capability hold; manual selected logits replay frozen native within 1e-4; block-component recombination, empty/base closure, full/donor-source closure, and Shapley efficiency are each within 2e-4; all records are finite and complete.
predictions.pred_b_boundary9_effect_recurrence: The all-components arm recovers 0.6445 plus or minus 0.03 in A1 and 0.5052 plus or minus 0.03 in A2, with donorward fraction 1.0.
predictions.pred_c_attention8_is_dominant_writer: Attention8 has the largest positive Shapley value among the three components in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_attention8_is_material: Omitting attention8 reduces mean recovery by at least 0.10 relative to the all-components arm in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 20 model forwards, 640 example evaluations, 512 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Promote block-8 attention at the subject-onset source bank and next partition its source positions/heads.
terminal.null: The exact cube is valid but attention is not the registered dominant material writer; retain the complete component effects and promote the observed winner only as a new hypothesis.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, replay, additive closure, full-effect recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: This is an exact end-to-end intervention on the block-8 output decomposition at the already localized source bank. It identifies a module-level writer contribution, not a unique attention head or upstream source token.
